examGuide.title: Approach the exam question
examGuide.body: Simulate frames after every reference and mark hits separately from replacements. A first reference into an empty frame is still a page fault. LRU uses last access; optimal uses farthest next access. LFU/MFU require a specified counting/reset and tie policy. Array traversal can cause repeated faults when its working set exceeds available frames.

examGuide.title: Worked problem
examGuide.body:
Three initially empty frames use LRU for references 1,2,3,1,4,2. How many faults occur?

**Answer: 5.** 1,2,3 fault and fill frames. 1 hits. 4 faults and evicts least-recent 2. The final 2 faults and evicts 3. Total=3+1+1=5.

examGuide.title: Conditions and edge cases
examGuide.body:
A replacement count can be smaller than a fault count because initial fills do not evict anything. Do not label both quantities interchangeably.

FIFO and LRU can make different victim choices after a hit.
